name: conversation-atlas-plus
description: A live map of your Claude Code session and your other sessions: your goal, what Claude is doing now, tasks, open questions, the conversation, activity and working files. Rebuilt from Conversation Atlas (MIT, by Neel).

author.name: Neel (original Conversation Atlas); rebuild by pk-cr

summaries.title: Summaries
summaries.description: both (default): after each answer a short digest goes to Haiku, and /atlas sync asks Claude to re-read the session. each turn: only the Haiku digest. on demand: only /atlas sync. off: no model calls; the map uses engine events and what you set. Every call goes through this session's own Anthropic client.

desktopSessions.title: Desktop sessions in the list
desktopSessions.description: on (default): the Sessions list adds your other sessions from the Claude desktop app on this Mac (titles and state). off: only sessions Atlas mapped.
